text:
talia.partners: Planning SI Field Roadshow (week of Jun 8). Goal: 3 regional cohorts, each with a 1-day lab + 1/2 day certification. Need: trainer roster, cloud sandbox access, HW voucher plan, marketplace self-deploy checklist. Thoughts? :speaker_high_volume:
ren.eng: I can do the "deploy & ops" session for region west. Will demo Dedicated templates + failover routing. Need a sandbox stack with model pinned and sample traffic.
michelle.devex: I'll draft the certification pass criteria and a short practical task (deploy + smoke test). Prefer timed remote proctoring for written section.
lee.hwlogistics: Hardware partner can provide loaner gear for 2 cohorts (4 units each). Shipping window 2026-06-01 to 06-03. We'll collect customs/docs once we have addresses.
talia.partners: Good. For marketplace self-deploy checklist I want a minimal set so SIs can validate quickly. Proposed minimal checklist: repo + manifest, openapi sample, env var list, autoscale hints, observability endpoints. Add missing items?
ren.eng: Add: a known-good loadprofile script and a small sample dataset. Also note recommended quantization and token-length guidance.
michelle.devex: Also include instructions for exam upload (how to submit practical results) and a template for proctor notes.
talia.partners: Action list: 1) @ren.eng provide load script + sample manifest by 5/20. 2) @lee.hwlogistics gather shipping POC + HS codes by 5/18. 3) @michelle.devex publish cert rubric + proctor template by 5/22. 4) I'll coordinate marketing embargo and regional invites.
ops-bot: Created ticket PR-7890: "SI Field Roadshow logistics" assigned to talia.partners, due 2026-05-25.
ren.eng: Quick question: do we want SIs to bring their own cloud accounts for the hands-on or use our marketplace sandbox? Pros/cons?
michelle.devex: Prefer marketplace sandbox for consistent grading. We can also allow BYOC as stretch option.
lee.hwlogistics: For in-person cohorts we'll need a contact on each SI side to accept delivery and handle customs clearance. I'll draft a delivery acceptance form.
talia.partners: Perfect. Let's do a dry run internally week of 6/1. Who can attend the dry run?
ren.eng: I'll be there for the deploy flow walkthrough.
michelle.devex: I'll run a mock exam and proctor notes.
lee.hwlogistics: I'll validate packing list and label prints.
talia.partners: Thanks all. I'll update this thread with the GH materials link and the deliverable tracker. If anyone finds a gap in the checklist ping me. :white_check_mark:
